title: Refill Pickup Delay by Prescription
dataSources: Amazon order records (`amazon:order`), meal-plan inventory (`mealplan:item`), and pharmacy refill events (`pharmacy:refill`).
app: Household logistics telemetry from Amazon order history, meal-plan inventory tools, and pharmacy refill portals sent to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pharmacy:refill
| search pickup_delay_hr=*
| stats avg(pickup_delay_hr) as avg_pickup_delay_hr perc90(pickup_delay_hr) as p90_pickup_delay_hr count as samples by med_name
| sort 0 - avg_pickup_delay_hr
description: Measures refill pickup delay by medication.
value: Pickup delay shows whether the refill step is breaking at the pharmacy, the reminder, or the household schedule.
implementation: Send the relevant duration field for refill pickup delay to `index=personal` and review both average and p90 latency instead of relying on single examples.
visualization: Table of average and p90 refill pickup delay.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how long refill pickup delay usually takes, so slowdowns are obvious instead of anecdotal.
